name: Crullers or Wonders
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: three tablespoonfuls of melted lard or butter
ingredients.originalText: three tablespoonfuls of melted lard or butter
ingredients.quantityText: three tablespoonfuls of melted lard or butter

instructions.text: Mix very hard with sifted flour, as hard as can be rolled
Roll very thin like pie crust
Cut in squares three inches long and two wide
Cut several slits or lines lengthwise to within a quarter of an inch of the edges of the ends
Run your two forefingers through every other slit
Lay them down on the board edgewise and dent them
Fry in hot lard a light brown

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix very hard with sifted flour, as hard as can be rolled
2. Roll very thin like pie crust
3. Cut in squares three inches long and two wide
4. Cut several slits or lines lengthwise to within a quarter of an inch of the edges of the ends
5. Run your two forefingers through every other slit
6. Lay them down on the board edgewise and dent them
7. Fry in hot lard a light brown
